[edit | edit source]
In February 2023, the Government of Uttar Pradesh allocated ₹150 crore in its budget to establish three new universities in the state. These institutions were planned for the Vindhyachal, Devipatan, and Moradabad divisions.[1] On 1 November 2023, the Uttar Pradesh Cabinet gave formal approval for the establishment of a state university in Moradabad.[2][3]
The Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, Yogi Adityanath, laid the foundation stone for the Moradabad state university on 16 March 2024.[4] During the ceremony, he also announced that the university would be named after Guru Jambheshwar, the founder of the Bishnoi community.[4] According to local tradition, Guru Jambheshwar had arrived in Lodhipur Vishanpur town of Moradabad from Rajasthan 493 years ago, in 1587 AD (Vikram Samvat 1587).[5] On 11 June 2024, the state government formally approved the university’s official name as Guru Jambheshwar University.[6][7]

On 3 December 2024, Prof. Sachin Maheshwari was appointed as the first Vice Chancellor of the university.[8] The University Grants Commission (UGC) granted recognition to the university on 27 March 2025, with the university’s establishment being retroactively acknowledged from 8 November 2023.[9] The university’s official website and logo were unveiled on 14 July 2025.[10]
The Guru Jambheshwar University now oversees all the colleges within the Moradabad division that were previously affiliated with MJP Rohilkhand University, Bareilly.[11] A total of 372 colleges across the division are affiliated with the university, including 87 in Moradabad, 122 in Bijnor, 82 in Amroha, 37 in Rampur, and 44 in the Sambhal district.[9]
The university commenced teaching from the academic session 2025-26.
Established: 2025 (1 year ago) (2025)

[edit | edit source]
The university is presently functioning from a temporary campus at Govt Polytechnic, Kanth Road, Moradabad.[9] Construction of the permanent campus of the university at Hardaspur, Moradabad began in June 2024.[12] A Budget of Rs 299 Crore was allotted for construction of the permanent campus of the University.[13]

value.text:
Guru Jambheshwar University, Moradabad is a state public university in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet approved the establishment of a state university in Moradabad in November 2023. Its foundation stone was laid in March 2024, and the state government approved the name Guru Jambheshwar University in June 2024. The University Grants Commission recognized the institution in March 2025, retrospectively acknowledging its establishment from 8 November 2023; the Wikipedia infobox separately gives 2025 as its establishment year. Teaching began in the 2025–26 academic session.

The university has operated from a temporary campus at Government Polytechnic on Kanth Road, while construction of a permanent campus at Hardaspur began in June 2024. Its described academic structure comprises 74 schools in 12 faculties, spanning fields including humanities, engineering, sciences, agriculture, management, education and law. The source reports 372 affiliated colleges across the Moradabad division, though it does not give a statistical date for this count.
